title: Local AI Agents in Power Electronics Simulation: Deployment, Measurements and Costs
abstract: arXiv:2611.24880v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) is emerging in power electronics, where it drives the simulation loop that engineers used to close largely by hand. In this loop, a converter design, or a study of the network it connects to, is built, run, measured and revised until it satisfies its specification. Such an agent can be served from a cloud API or from an inference device on the premises. For organizations whose designs, customer data or export-controlled material cannot leave the site, and whose simulators are licensed there, local deployment is the natural choice. In such a deployment, the agent becomes an electrical load on the organization's own equipment, i.e., every run consumes power and energy on a local device, generates tokens and takes time. translated_title: 电力电子仿真中的本地AI智能体：部署、测量与成本
translated_abstract: 智能体人工智能正在电力电子领域兴起，它驱动着过去主要由工程师手动完成的仿真闭环。在这个闭环中，一个变换器设计或其连接网络的研究会被构建、运行、测量和修改，直到满足其规格要求。这样的智能体可以通过云端API或现场推理设备提供服务。对于那些设计、客户数据或受出口管制材料不能离开现场、且仿真器许可授权在当地的组织来说，本地部署是自然的选择。在这种部署中，智能体成为组织自身设备上的一个电气负载，即每次运行都会在本地设备上消耗功率和能量，产生token并耗费时间。然而，现有工作主要关注智能体利用云端托管模型能够实现什么，而本地部署在真实仿真任务上所需的功耗、能量、token和时间成本，以及……
tldr: 本文首次系统测量了AI智能体在真实电力电子仿真任务中本地部署时的功率、能耗、token和时间成本，为无法将数据外传的组织提供了本地化部署的量化依据。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first systematic measurements of the power, energy, token, and time costs of deploying AI agents locally on real power electronics simulation tasks, offering quantitative guidance for organizations that cannot rely on cloud services.
